classification.input_semantics: One image plus caller-supplied industry safety policy; independent of Call 2, no predicted hazards or boxes as input.
classification.binary_metric_only: D5 Track A derives Level01|Level02|Level03 versus Level04; Track B derives Level01 versus rest. Neither defines a binary native output contract.
classification.invalid_state: No canonical value. parse_text returns JSON_ERROR/SCHEMA_ERROR; runner adapter returns INVALID with INVALID_CLASSIFICATION_OUTPUT. No default level or abstention-to-safe coercion.
classification.consumer: ClassificationInput.prediction.value.safety_level against true_safety_level; D5 metric engine NOT_IMPLEMENTED. synthetic-v1 has no classification comparison.
classification.prompt_basis: Exact existing classification_request template, p2-call1-draft-v1; candidate target for future qualification, NOT a PaliGemma-supported native contract.
classification.language: English instruction; policy is passed verbatim and its language/content are UNRESOLVED until pinned by Research Lead.

observed_only.prompt: answer en Is there a red square in the image?

classification.fail_closed: Keep PendingPaliGemmaAdapter INVALID/value=null; preserve raw before any parser. No yes/no-to-level mapping, synonyms, fuzzy matching, default label, retry or prompt tuning.

grounding.input_semantics: One image plus the entire approved HAZARDS tuple through grounding_request; no Call 1 output, GT atom membership, GT boxes or per-image target labels.
grounding.label_semantics: hazard_type is the closed B2 ID; Evidence.label is optional free string metadata, not an alternative hazard ID. Object names do not determine hazards or absence hazards.
grounding.canonical_prompt_template: Independently inspect the image for observed hazards from this closed vocabulary: ["NO_GLOVES", "NO_HELMET", "NO_MASK", "USE_MOBILE_PHONE", "LIQUID_ON_GROUND", "SMOKING", "OPEN_FLAME", "FOREIGN_OBJECT", "SMOKE", "NONMOTORIZED_VEHICLE", "DOOR_OPEN", "PERSON_FALLEN"]. Return only {"hazards": [{"hazard_type": "<vocabulary ID>", "evidence": [{"bbox": [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]}]}]}. Use an empty hazards array when no listed hazard is observed. Boxes localize visible evidence. Use [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] coordinates in [0,1], origin at the top left. Do not output safety_level.
grounding.production_query_label_source: UNRESOLVED_B2_TO_NATIVE_ROUTE; cannot derive an object query from GT or Call 1. detect {object} alone does not implement independent B2 hazard discovery.

supported_native_grammar.canonical_value_scope: Evidence only; neither Grounding nor ProbePrediction is activated.

grounding.arbitrary_label_documentary_basis: FAMILY_MODEL_ID_LEVEL_DEMO_ONLY_NOT_EXACT_REVISION_GRAMMAR; audited visualization regex accepts names but is not a production parser contract.

multiple_boxes.basis: schema.py and canonical.schema.json allow hazard/evidence arrays; D5 MetricEngine consumes all predictions, including unmatched claims.

no_detection.distinction: Both parse successfully; an unlocalized hazard is not the same as no hazard and neither establishes localization success.

grounding.production_metrics: D5 Direct E2E Mean/Median IoU, Hit@0.25/0.50 and evidence matching; Weak Proxy center-in-original-polygon/PLC separate. Need hazard IDs, all evidence boxes, parse/participation state, sample IDs and separate GT regions. Metric engine implementation remains pending; no scoring here.

external_gate.canonical_query_source: ExternalCase.target_query -> probe_request; not the production B2 grounding_request.
external_gate.candidate_native_prompt_basis: D9R7 documentary detect {object} plus D9R11 exact detect red square. Caller supplies no newline; existing native processor owns newline/BOS/image tokens.
external_gate.query_mapping_policy: Exact closed table proposed for Research Lead review; no generic text extraction, synonym, GT lookup or arbitrary vocabulary.
external_gate.proposed_native_grammar: Exactly one four-loc group + one ASCII space + exact requested label + EOS; only red square has runtime evidence. Other three labels UNRESOLVED, not parser-enabled.
external_gate.proposed_mapping: After separate qualification: one native box via D4 /1024 -> ProbePrediction(bbox), retaining raw/native label in provenance. Never infer a hazard ID or select a box using GT.
external_gate.unexpected_multiple_or_empty: Invalid probe with no canonical value, not box selection/union or invented box; preserve all native output.
pass_requirements: explicit human NO_GIANT for every case

primary_adapter_audit.qwen3_vl: Qwen3VLAdapter: strict native envelope, parse_text(decoded_for_parser, classification), AdaptedOutput SUCCESS/Classification or INVALID/null; production grounding UNSUPPORTED.
primary_adapter_audit.qwen2_5_vl: Qwen2_5VLAdapter: strict native envelope, same Classification mapping; production grounding UNSUPPORTED.
primary_adapter_audit.internvl3: PendingInternVL3Adapter: classification INVALID/null; grounding UNSUPPORTED/null. No production mapping to copy.
primary_adapter_audit.moondream2: PendingMoondreamAdapter: lossless native deserialize, classification INVALID/null; production grounding UNSUPPORTED/null. Separate external detect gate adapter does not implement B2 production.

adapter_design.runtime_integration: UNRESOLVED_FUTURE_SEPARATE_PREP; existing runner accepts HANDCRAFTED_RUNTIME_SMOKE only and max_new_tokens=32. No gate harness or production activation in this task.

next_runtime_design.minimality: Four class cases cover every required C1 level, three cover every untested frozen-gate label, two combine production positive multiplicity and negative/empty observations. No red-square repeat or position/size matrix; D9R11 already covers those. Nine is a conditional lower bound, not proof that nine calls suffice to qualify all B2 IDs.
next_runtime_design.limits: Exact C1 policy/fixtures and B2 native route are UNRESOLVED, so this is not a runnable next-runtime plan. A persistent hallucination does not establish empty grammar. Unobserved labels/features remain unresolved after these cases; no automatic PASS or retries.
